description: This file defines the Gauge metric type for Prometheus client in Go, including interfaces, constructors, and methods for creating and manipulating gauge metrics, as well as gauge vector types for labeled gauges.

classes.name: gauge
classes.description: Implementation of the Gauge interface, representing a single numerical metric that can go up and down, with atomic operations for thread safety.

classes.name: GaugeVec
classes.description: A collection of Gauges sharing the same description but differentiated by label values.

classes.name: GaugeFunc
classes.description: A Gauge whose value is determined dynamically at collection time via a callback function.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the gauge to an arbitrary float64 value.

methods.name: SetToCurrentTime
methods.description: Sets the gauge to the current Unix timestamp in seconds.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a specified float64 value to the gauge.

methods.name: Sub
methods.description: Subtracts a specified float64 value from the gauge.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Serializes the gauge metric into the protobuf format.

methods.name: NewGauge
methods.description: Creates a new Gauge instance with specified options.

methods.name: NewGaugeVec
methods.description: Creates a new GaugeVec with specified options and label names.

methods.name: GetMetricWithLabelValues
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Gauge for the given label values.

methods.name: GetMetricWith
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Gauge for the given label map.

methods.name: WithLabelValues
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Gauge for the given label values, panicking on error.

methods.name: With
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Gauge for the given label map, panicking on error.

methods.name: CurryWith
methods.description: Returns a new GaugeVec with some labels pre-set.

methods.name: MustCurryWith
methods.description: Returns a new GaugeVec with labels pre-set, panicking on error.

methods.name: NewGaugeFunc
methods.description: Creates a Gauge whose value is determined by a callback function at collection time.
